eyebrow: The critical path, split in two

steps.label: Happy path
steps.sub: student registers for a section with an open seat

steps.label: Full section
steps.sub: student is correctly rejected, no seat quietly consumed

code:
Open form -> set section (open seat)
 -> click Register
 -> assert status = "Confirmed"
 -> assert seat count decremented by 1
caption: Proves the application does the one thing it exists to do.

code:
Open form -> set section (0 open seats)
 -> click Register
 -> assert status = "Rejected - Section Full"
 -> assert seat count unchanged
 -> assert waitlist option offered
caption: The path that actually generates support tickets when it's wrong.

code:
Input: max_seats=30, enrolled_count=30
  -> assert capacityCheck() == false
Input: max_seats=30, enrolled_count=29
  -> assert capacityCheck() == true
caption: Tests the capacity math directly, independent of the UI.
